annotations.text:
Aurora: cool charcoal, teal + violet accents, glass over a faint two-corner glow.
Dark is the primary theme; light keeps the same structure.
Status colours: teal = ok, amber = waiting, violet = needs a human, rose = blocked.
Company names are invented sample data.
Two tone alternates on the same glass system. Pick one, or keep Aurora.

Four directions that are not glass, each on its own axis. Same content as Aurora so only the look differs.
Ledger: warm paper, serif, ruled lists, one vermilion. Calm and unlike any CRM; dark mode becomes an 'ink' inversion, and status must carry on text more than colour.
Bento: cream ground, tinted columns, pill-shaped everything. Friendly and quick to read; the risk is reading as a consumer app.
Noir: black, ivory, gold hairlines, serif titles. Premium and quiet; density costs are real and light mode is an afterthought.
Terminal: monospace operator console, grid, bracketed tags, key hints. Most distinctive and densest; the least forgiving for a non-developer.
